name: Turn-of-Month Seasonality
description: Pure calendar rotation holding an equal-weight equity sleeve (broad global/regional equities) during the turn-of-month window (last 2 trading days of current month + first 3 trading days of next month) and rotating into a defensive sleeve (VUTY, SGLN, AGGU, SEGA) for the remainder of the month. Implements the Turn-of-the-Month Effect seasonal pattern observed in equity returns around month boundaries.
